verdict.rationale: Workable documents automation-adjacent features: webhook subscriptions, an MCP server, and the Workable Agent for sourcing and screening. None of the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of automations. Automation governance is a fair question for a recruiting platform with automated workflows, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
